description:
Migrate `Components.AssistantMessage.TextBlock`,
`Components.AssistantMessage.ThinkingBlock`, and
`Components.CompactionSummaryMessage` to the VDom contract.

These are streaming-aware: today they implement the `update/2` +
`finalize/2` callbacks. Under VDom, those callbacks disappear.
Snapshots are passed in as props by the parent (Transcript hole
reads them off the live `%MessageState{}`); the component reads
the previous render-state from a `use_state` hook cell, applies
the snapshot delta via the existing pure helper
(`MdRender.put/2`, etc.), and stores the new state.

TextBlock and ThinkingBlock both delegate to the markdown
subsystem (d06.10): once that ticket lands, these become thin
~30-line wrappers that compose `Components.Markdown` with a small
header and styling. CompactionSummaryMessage is even simpler —
plain text with theme styling.

Acceptance:
  * Structs and `@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component` callbacks
    deleted.
  * Existing transcript_test.exs assertions stay green.
  * Streaming smoke test in tmux shows tokens append at the same
    cadence as today; telemetry confirms hook-cell snapshot churn
    is exactly one set_state per delta.
title: Convert AssistantMessage blocks + CompactionSummaryMessage
